entities.summary: Tetsuya Mizuguchi (b. 1965-05-22, Otaru) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Otaru and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
